ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: The following figure is a schematic diagram of the formation and development process of the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau. <image1> The formation of the funnels in the figure is due to what action?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of the formation and development process of the Yunnan-Guizhou Plateau, divided into multiple stage diagrams. One can see the uplift of limestone layers, underground karst caves/underground rivers, peak forests and other karst landforms; in the legend, karst landform symbols such as “funnel” and “stalactite” are marked, among which the funnel appears as a depressed negative landform on the surface. Then reason: the question only asks about the formation process of the funnel in the figure. Karst funnels are mainly formed when water containing carbon dioxide seeps downward along limestone fissures, dissolving and eroding soluble rocks, causing the surface gradually to collapse or be dissolved into funnel-shaped depressions. Therefore, the formation of the funnel is not fluvial deposition, but fluvial dissolution.
